API portal architecture

The core of api.virev.ai is clean and follows our standards. The edges carry about 6,000 lines of leftovers and second copies, and two monitoring gaps hid failed customer calls. This page answers the owner's question in #dev-api-portal p23 (mwwhn4a3), with code read at dev/sieun 0361cb16a4 and prod counts read on 2026-11-25.

What is clean and what is not

The clean core is one gateway path that admits, reads and charges every /v1 call (apps/api-portal/src/lib/server/gateway.ts:752). Each charge and each admitted call inserts its own Convex row, so parallel calls never write the same document. The /v1 routes come from the operation catalog, every hot query reads through an index, and money is integer micro-dollars.

For example, when one org fires 30 calls at once, each charge inserts one move row in apiPortalBalances (convex/apiPortal/balances.ts:122-135), and a fold sums the moves about once a second. The catch-all route file holds one line (apps/api-portal/src/routes/v1/[...path=v1get]/+server.ts:1). Around that core sit old compat code, copies of the gateway and of the org lists, and alert rules that miss quiet hours.

How one call moves

A customer call takes two Convex asks on the request path, one to admit and one to charge, and everything we count lands in one ClickHouse table.

flowchart TD
  cust(["customer"]) --> gw("gateway on Vercel")
  gw -- "1 admit" --> cx[("Convex apiPortal")]
  gw -- "2 read" --> vent("Vent /crawler")
  vent --> cr("crawler-v3")
  gw -- "3 charge" --> cx
  cx -- "outbox" --> cr
  cr --> ch[("product.usage_events")]
  gw -- "events" --> ph("PostHog 354457")
  ch -- "hourly sync" --> ph
  ch --> gf("Grafana and alerts")

For example, a GET /v1/youtube/channel_shorts call spends a median 100 ms in the admit ask, about 6 s in the crawler and 81 ms in the charge ask. The charge puts a data_api_call row in the Convex outbox, which crawler-v3 writes to ClickHouse, and the crawler writes its own crawl_read row for the same call.

The tables

The portal owns 17 Convex tables in convex/apiPortal/tables.ts and uses 4 more from the org and ledger code, plus 4 ClickHouse tables. The table lists the ones that matter, with prod rows read on 2026-11-25.

For example, the billing page shows a balance from apiPortalBalances and its 30-day spend from data_api_call rows in product.usage_events (apps/api-portal/src/lib/usage-ledger.ts:18-25).

The other tables

Small Convex tables hold settings and state, such as apiPortalCards (12 rows), apiPortalAutoReplenish (2), apiPortalCoupons (11) and apiPortalOrgFunnel (4). The rest are apiPortalPlaygroundRuns (16), apiPortalFoldChain (1), apiPortalCronCursors (1), chargeKeys (255), ledgerOrgDrains (151) and the batch item and part tables. apiPortalRateQuotas and apiPortalRateRequests hold 0 rows on prod, so nobody has used raised rate limits. In ClickHouse, product.usage_daily (3,126 rows) and product.mcp_calls (2,379) are rollups that materialized views fill from usage_events, and no portal code reads them.

One call is counted three ways that disagree. Over 7 days on prod there were 30,861 keyed crawl_read rows, 25,274 data_api_call charges and 24,829 PostHog api_request_completed events. The board and the alert count the crawl rows, while the usage page and the PostHog warehouse count the charges.

Problems, worst first

  • The calls-failing alert skips any hour under 20 customer calls (apps/infra/metal/config/obs/grafana/alerting/api-portal.yaml:144), so it was blind 134 of 169 hours holding 479 failed calls.
  • Six places decide which orgs are ours, with four definitions, so a funnel proof org on 11-25 paid real balance and fired api_first_call (convex/org/customerWorkspaces.ts:43).
  • Prod answers /api/test/seed and /api/test/cleanup behind one shared secret (convex/apiPortal/portalHttp.ts:466-500), and cleanup can delete any named org's keys and balance.
  • The /v1/intelligence/profile route copies the gateway by hand, so a crawler crawl_unpaid_paused reaches the customer as a plain 502 (apps/api-portal/src/routes/v1/intelligence/profile/+server.ts:185).
  • A CONVEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET mismatch would tell every customer 401 invalid_api_key, because the gateway reads any Convex 401 as a revoked key (apps/api-portal/src/lib/server/gateway.ts:202-205).
  • Live reads set no timeout and drop the client's abort signal (apps/api-portal/src/lib/server/live-reads.ts:115-121), so a client that hangs up is still charged.
  • The board and the alert read only crawl_read rows (api-portal.yaml:141), so they miss the 909 refused calls of the last 7 days.
  • Nothing ages out of product.usage_events (apps/crawler-v3/src/events/ledger.py:78-120) or apiPortalCrawlJobs, and staging already holds 7.5M rows.
  • The schema reference says every portal table is per-workspace and lists apiPortalUsage (.agents/skills/stack/convex/references/schema.md:13), though 6 tables are system tables and apiPortalUsage is gone.

The cost of the first problem is concrete. The 479 failed calls were mostly proxy_provider_down answers before 2026-11-23 22:58Z, and no alert fired for any of them. The test route problem left $26 of deposits on one house org with no credit row, because seeding adds balance without one.

Cuts on offer

About 1,500 lines of compat and 410 code serve no customer and can go without an owner call. compat.ts (221 lines) and compat-paths.ts (630) rebuild old answers for 11 paths, and the 410 routes add about 440 more. The Vercel log drain shows the last call from a known customer org on 10-28, and every 410 since 11-02 went to us-metal02 or a bot.

Landing A and landing B both ship (apps/api-portal/src/routes/(marketing)/+page.svelte:29-33), and only the owner can pick one. Keeping A removes about 4,700 lines, and keeping B removes about 2,600. Hand-typed price copies, two job systems and legacy fields make up the rest of the 6,000 lines.

Being fixed now

The api-portal agent started three fixes on 2026-11-25. The alert will count failed customer calls over a longer window. One Convex definition of our orgs will feed the board, the alert and the duties, and the test routes will register off prod only.
